requirement: The route from router r1 to the server network 10.0.2.0/24 is missing. Restore it using the transit link.

proposal.rationale: The requirement specifies that the route from router r1 to the server network 10.0.2.0/24 is missing and needs to be restored using the transit link. According to the rules, the only valid next hop for traffic on r1 heading towards the server network is 10.0.12.2.
